snippet.title: Santa vs Elfbots | Pixel-Art Action RPG | Closed Beta Trailer
snippet.description:
An AI has cancelled Christmas, robots have replaced the elves, and Santa has a candy cane. The prologue of Santa vs Elfbots: Who Cancelled Christmas? is in closed beta on Mac and Windows.

Join the closed beta: https://santavselfbots.com/#beta

Santa vs Elfbots is a pixel-art action RPG, in development. You play Santa. He swapped his elves for robots, and Elfy, the AI running them, has cancelled Christmas. Take the North Pole back one zone at a time with a candy cane, snowballs and a Ho ho ho! that sends robots flying, and win back the elves he let go.

🎄 THE CLOSED BETA 🎄

I’m looking for players who’ll help me build the final game. What you get:
• The “Beta XMAS” pack: exclusive extras in the full game, yours to claim when it comes out.*
• The prologue, before everyone else.
• A place on the game’s Discord, where the beta is discussed.
*Claimable only by beta testers who signed up by email.

I pick the testers from the sign-up list and write to them when the beta opens. No email is sent before that.

🎄 LINKS 🎄

Website: https://santavselfbots.com/
Beta sign-up: https://santavselfbots.com/#beta
itch.io: https://santa-vs-elfbots.itch.io/the-game
Discord: https://discord.gg/mJFtjgYMrw
Press kit: https://santavselfbots.com/press/

🎄 HOW IT’S MADE 🎄

I design the game and make every decision: the story, the characters, the world, the rules and the art direction. AI tools help me build it. Images are generated, then processed and retouched to become the game’s pixel art. AI audio tools produce part of the sound effects and music, and the voices of Elfy and Santa. For the code and the writing, I work with assistants. I direct them, and I check what they do. More in the FAQ: https://santavselfbots.com/#faq

🎄 CREDITS 🎄

A game by Quentin Mousset · Published by BEDEV CONSULTING
Made with Godot.

Elfy is a fictional AI. Any resemblance to a real assistant is a coincidence. Mostly.

#SantaVsElfbots #PixelArt #IndieGame
